# Wondrr

> Wondrr is a group travel marketplace where solo travellers in India discover and book
> fixed-departure trips from 50+ verified travel brands — without coordinating on WhatsApp
> or browsing a dozen websites. Every host is vetted, every trip has a set departure date,
> and groups are capped at 15 so everyone is a real part of the trip.

Wondrr (https://wondrr.in) operates in India (en-IN). It aggregates group trips from
independent, verified travel hosts and travel brands, letting travellers book safe group
adventures with like-minded people.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://wondrr.in/): Discover group trips and fixed departures.
- [All Trips](https://wondrr.in/trips): Browse every available group trip with filters by destination, duration, and price.
- [All-Girls Trips](https://wondrr.in/girls-trips): Curated women-only group departures.
- [About Wondrr](https://wondrr.in/about): Platform mission and how host verification works.
- [How We Work](https://wondrr.in/how-we-work): Booking process and what travellers can expect.
- [Partner With Us](https://wondrr.in/partner-with-us): For travel operators who want to list trips.
- [Blog](https://wondrr.in/blog): Travel tips, destination guides, and group travel stories from the Wondrr team.
- [Booking Policy](https://wondrr.in/booking-policy): Terms, cancellation, and refunds.

## Trip Categories

- **Weekend getaways (2N/3D):** Rishikesh, Mcleodganj, Chakrata, Shimla, Kasol — from ₹5,500
- **Himalayan treks:** Spiti Valley, Manali, Kasol, Chopta Chandrashila, Triund, Valley of Flowers
- **Bike expeditions:** Ladakh (via Hanle / Tsomoriri), Spiti Valley — from ₹35,000
- **International tours:** Bali, Thailand (Full Moon Party), Japan (Tokyo–Osaka), Vietnam, Georgia, Sri Lanka, Almaty
- **All-girls trips:** Women-only fixed departures across India and international destinations

## Pricing

₹5,500 – ₹1,59,999 per person (INR). Fixed-departure dates. All bookings made directly on platform. No third-party coordinators.

## Verified Hosts

All hosts are vetted by Wondrr before listing trips. Example operators: Cliffseas travels, The Trippers, International Youth Club, OhBhaiSahab, JapsTours, CaptureATrip. Host profiles live at https://wondrr.in/<host-username>.

## Content

- Trip pages live at https://wondrr.in/trip/<slug> and include day-by-day itinerary, inclusions/exclusions, departure dates, per-person pricing (INR), host details, and traveller reviews.
- Blog posts live at https://wondrr.in/blog/<slug> and cover travel tips, destination guides, solo travel advice, and group travel stories written by the Wondrr team.
- The full URL inventory is in the sitemap: https://wondrr.in/sitemap.xml

## Notes

- All hosts on Wondrr are verified travel brands.
- Groups are intentionally capped at 15 travellers per departure.
- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR). Bookings are made directly on the platform.
